the novel 21.7 kb gross deletion in SLC 25A13 gene was the hitherto-largest deletion in the mutation spectrum of this gene and that this deletion completely silenced the transcriptional expression and the translational expression of this gene.

the novel large deletion c.(-3251)-c.15+1844del21709bp in SLC25 A13 gene completely silenced the transcriptional/translation expression of the affected allele, and the Western blotting analysis of citrin protein in peripheral blood lymphocytes was a new minimally invasive and more-feasibly approach for NICCD molecular diagnosis.

the NICCD definite diagnosis was made by molecular diagnosis of the novel gross deletion c.-3252_c.15+18843del21709 bp, and the novel deletion, which silences the transcription of the affected SCL25A13 allele and completely abrogates the citrin protein expression, was identified by Western blotting approach and cDNA cloning.
